1.ja: ת'ם כלמהם אללה. בגמיע הד'א אלכלאם קאילא
1.en: Then God spoke to them all of this discourse, saying:

2.en: who brought you out from the land of Egypt

3.ja: לא יכון לך מעבוד אכ'ר מן דוני.
3.en: You shall have no other object of worship besides Me

4.ja: לא תצנע לך פסלא ולא שבהא
4.en: You shall not make for yourself a graven image nor a likeness
of what is in the sky in the heights
or of what is in the earth in the depths
or of what is in the water beneath the earth

5.en: You shall not bow down to them nor worship them
for I am God your Lord, the Able, the Punisher
5.he: כִּי אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֵל קַנָּא

5.en: who demands the sins of the fathers together with the sons
and the third and the fourth generation, for those who hate Me

6.en: and who does good to thousands
among those who love Me and keep My commandments

7.ja: לא תחלף באסם אללה רבך באטלא
7.en: You shall not swear by the name of God your Lord falsely

7.ja: לאן אללה לא יברי. מן יחלף באסמה באטלא
7.en: for God will not acquit one who swears by His name falsely
7.he: כִּי לֹא יְנַקֶּה יְהוָה אֵת אֲשֶׁר-יִשָּׂא אֶת-שְׁמוֹ לַשָּׁוְא

8.en: Remember the day of the Sabbath and sanctify it

10.en: But the seventh day is a Sabbath to God your Lord
you shall do nothing of the crafts
you, and your son and your daughter
your male servant and your maidservant and your beasts
and your guest who is in your place

11.ja: לאן אללה כ'לק פי סת איאם אלסמא ואלארץ'
11.en: For God created in six days the sky and the earth
11.he: כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת-יָמִים עָשָׂה יְהוָה אֶת-הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֶת-הָאָרֶץ

11.en: and the sea and all that is in them
and gave them rest on the seventh day

11.ja: לד'אלך בארך אללה. פי יום אלסבת וקדסה
11.en: therefore God bestowed His blessing upon the day of the Sabbath and sanctified it

12.en: Honor your father and your mother
so that your span of days may be long

12.ja: פי אלבלד. אלד'י אללה רבך מעטיך
12.en: in the land which God your Lord is giving you
12.he: עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר-יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ נֹתֵן לָךְ

13.en: You shall not kill a person

13.ja: לא תשהד עלי' צאחבך שהאדה באטלה
13.en: You shall not bear false witness against your fellow

14.en: You shall not covet the house of your fellow
you shall not covet his wife
nor his male servant and his maidservant and his ox and his donkey

15.en: And all the people were beholding the thunderclaps and the bolts of fire
and the sound of the horn
and the mountain enveloped in smoke
and when they saw this, they were terrified
and they stood at a distance

16.en: Speak to us yourself — we will hear from you
but let not God speak to us, lest we perish

17.ja: פאן לכי ימתחנכם. תגלא לכם נור אללה
17.en: for it is in order to test you that the light of God appeared to you
17.he: כִּי לְבַעֲבוּר נַסּוֹת אֶתְכֶם בָּא הָאֱלֹהִים

17.en: and in order that His awe may be in your hearts

18.en: And the people stood at a distance
while Moses drew near to the thick cloud
where the light of God was

19.en: Thus say to the sons of Israel
that from the heavens I addressed you

20.ja: לא תצנעו מעי. מעבודאת מן פצ'ה
20.en: You shall not make alongside Me objects of worship of silver

20.ja: ומעבודאת מן ד'הב. לא תצנעוהא לכם
20.en: nor objects of worship of gold — you shall not make them for yourselves

21.en: An altar of earth you shall make for Me
and sacrifice upon it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings
from your flock and your cattle
in every place where I cause My name to be remembered
I will appear to you and bestow My blessing upon you

22.ja: ואן צנעת לי מד'בחא מן חגארה
22.en: And if you make for Me an altar of stones
you shall not build them hewn

22.ja: לאנך אן חרכת חדידך עליהא בד'לתהא
22.en: for if you move your iron tool upon them, you have degraded them

23.en: And you shall not ascend by steps upon My altar
so that your nakedness not be uncovered upon it
